title: Admin Troll Menu
description: This project adds a unique gui with over 30+ things to troll your players with that doesnt ruin the game for content creation
body:
TrollMenu gives server admins a slick GUI packed with over 35 troll effects to unleash on unsuspecting players — perfect for YouTube videos, Twitch streams, or just having a laugh with friends. From summoning a Warden for two terrifying seconds to raining fish from the sky, every button is designed to get a reaction.

All effects are designed to be non-destructive — items are preserved, no permanent damage is dealt, and a single "Stop All" button kills every active effect instantly.
/troll— list online players
/troll <player>— open the troll GUI on that player
 😈 TrollMenu

The ultimate admin troll toolkit — 35+ chaotic, scary, and hilarious effects for content creators.

TrollMenu gives server admins a slick GUI packed with over 35 troll effects to unleash on unsuspecting players — perfect for YouTube videos, Twitch streams, or just having a laugh with friends. From summoning a Warden for two terrifying seconds to raining fish from the sky, every button is designed to get a reaction.

All effects are **non-destructive** — items are preserved, no permanent damage is dealt, and a single "Stop All" button kills every active effect instantly.

---

 👻 Scary / Horror
- **Flash Warden** — Spawns a Warden for 2 seconds with a roar and sculk particles
- **Warden Footsteps** — Looping creepy footstep sounds with *"something is near..."* actionbar
- **Herobrine Visit** — A still, silent figure appears in the distance then vanishes in smoke
- **Fake Ender Dragon** — Dragon roar, flapping, and breath particles with full title screen
- **Cave Sounds** — Random ambient horror sounds (ghast, spider, skeleton...)
- **Lightning Strike** — Visual lightning strike at their feet (no damage)
- **Particle Prison** — Rotating ring of witch/end-rod particles surrounding the player
- **Void Edge** — Teleported to Y=5 with levitation, staring into the abyss
- **Phantom Swarm** — 5 aggressive phantoms that target them then disappear
- **Spawn Flash Giant** — A towering Giant mob looms near them briefly

## 🎉 Chaos / Funny
- **Fake Explosion** — Massive boom sound + particles, zero actual damage
- **Random Teleport Loop** — Yanked to a random location every 3 seconds
- **Gravity Flip** — Launched sky-high every time they touch the ground
- **Bouncy Floor** — Slime-block bounce on every landing for 15 seconds
- **Anvil Rain** — 8 falling anvils drop around them (no hurt entities)
- **Rain of Fish** — 20 raw cod fall from the sky. No explanation needed.
- **Send to Sky** — Launched to Y=250 with levitation, then saved by slow falling
- **Compass Spin** — Camera spins wildly for a few seconds
- **Inventory Scramble** — Every item in their inventory randomly shuffled
- **Drop All Items** — Entire inventory drops on the floor (items stay, no despawn)

## 🧪 Status Effects
- **Blindness Bomb** — Blindness + Darkness for 10 seconds
- **Nausea Wave** — Maximum nausea, everything spins for 8 seconds
- **Speed Surge** — Speed 6, completely uncontrollable for 5 seconds
- **Freeze** — Max slowness + jump suppression, can't move for 5 seconds
- **Chaos Potion Cocktail** — Levitation + Nausea + Wither + Poison + Weakness all at once
- **Hunger Drain** — Food set to zero with max hunger effect
- **Fire Aura** — Surrounded by flame and lava particles (no actual fire damage)
- **Vampire Mode** — Burns in daylight (cosmetic fire only)
- **Matrix Mode** — Non-stop chaotic particles and horror ambient sounds on loop

## 🧠 Mind Games
- **Fake Chat Message** — Sends a convincing `[SERVER] You have been banned!` style message
- **Fake Server Crash** — 5-second countdown restart screen... then "JK lol"
- **Fake Creeper Hiss** — Creeper primed sound + title + delayed explosion sound
- **XP Drain** — All levels disappear for 5 seconds, then restored
- **Fake Death Screen** — Full "YOU DIED" title + death sound + brief movement freeze

---
Permission node: `trollmenu.use` — granted to OP by default.

⚠ **Intended for friendly use between consenting players.** All effects are cosmetic or temporary — no items are permanently lost, and the "Stop All Trolls" button instantly cancels every active loop. Best used with friends or for content where players know trolling may occur.
